name: Saint Pierre and Miquelon
prevalence_note: No archipelago-specific official scam notice was found; national French guidance on fake parcel messages and La Poste's help pages are the applicable references.
cross_border_note: Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon (+508) sits next to Canada, so +1 Canadian numbers are common alongside mainland French (+33) calls.

scams.name: Faux message La Poste ou banque
scams.name_en: Fake La Poste or bank message asking for a fee or secret code in Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon
scams.signals_en: A message claiming La Poste or a bank requests a small payment or a security code to release a parcel or unblock an account.
scams.legit_en: French national guidance and La Poste state they never ask for a secret code by text.
bait_tactics: Demander si le colis est au bureau de poste de Saint-Pierre
Dire que la tempête a retardé le bateau et que seul l'avis papier fait foi
